title: Mistral moves to Small and gains vision support
summary:
Mistral Small gained vision support and updated API routes, while a project link and outdated text API documentation got tidied up.

The `mistral` chat model was updated from Mistral Nemo to Mistral Small and marked as supporting vision. Two PRs added OpenAI-compatible configurations for direct Vertex AI and Scaleway routes, including streaming endpoint selection and translation of `seed` to Mistral’s `random_seed` parameter.

PrivatePollenAI’s author link now points to MMojoCoder’s GitHub profile. Its app and repository links are unchanged.

The README no longer claims a 20-requests-per-minute per-IP limit. An unused, commented-out rate limiter was removed too; request handling did not change.

highlights.title: Mistral Small gains vision
highlights.text: The `mistral` chat model now uses Mistral Small and is marked as supporting image inputs. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral).
